jobs.title: US Head of Vertical Market – Life Sciences
jobs.description:
At Siemens, we empower our customers by combining the real and digital worlds to improve how we live, work, and move today and for future generations. Our people are at the center of everything we do, driving innovation, collaboration, and sustainable growth.

**We are looking for a US Head of Vertical Market – Life Sciences.**

The One Tech Company transformation is creating new opportunities for Siemens to bring together innovative technologies, deep industry expertise, and cross-business collaboration to serve customers in more meaningful ways. The US Head of Vertical Market – Life Sciences will help lead this effort across one of Siemens' most important strategic markets. This role will serve as a key connector across businesses, stakeholders, and customers, helping to align market strategies, unlock growth opportunities, and strengthen Siemens' position throughout the Life Sciences ecosystem.

**You'll Make an Impact By**

* Leading Siemens USA’s growth strategy and business plan for the assigned Vertical, aligning global Vertical priorities with US market trends, customer needs, competitive insights, and the One Tech Company ambition.
* Serving as the US representative for the global Vertical and as the primary local coordination point for Siemens US leadership, the global Vertical organization, Siemens businesses, customers, partners, and other internal and external stakeholders.
* Operating as an integrated member of the global Vertical organization, with a solid-line reporting relationship within Siemens US and a strong dotted-line relationship into the global Vertical organization.
* Leading strategic opportunity capture and pursuits by mobilizing Siemens businesses, orchestrating cross-business resources and executive sponsorship, and creating a coordinated One Tech Company experience for customers.
* Building and leading the US Vertical community across businesses, functions, sales teams, regions, and channels to align priorities, strengthen collaboration, and accelerate growth.
* Developing and executing the US Vertical business plan, including market priorities, target segments, focus accounts, strategic opportunities, ecosystem partnerships, and growth initiatives.
* Determining the localization of global Vertical strategy, including US go-to-market approaches, account focus, sales motions, channel and partner strategies, and coordinated marketing execution.
* Building trusted executive customer and ecosystem relationships, representing Siemens in the market, and expanding Siemens’ influence through industry engagement, advocacy, and thought leadership.
* Acting as the voice of the US customer, market, and industry by translating insights into enterprise action, portfolio priorities, solution development, investment choices, enablement needs, and business results.
* Leveraging global Vertical leadership, market development, architecture, subject matter experts, and other supporting capabilities to accelerate local strategy, opportunity development, solution design, and execution.
* Identifying cross-business synergies, portfolio and capability needs, solution gaps, resource requirements, and investment priorities, and aligning the appropriate Siemens businesses and functions to address them.
* Ensuring relevant Siemens capabilities—including sales enablement, marketing, financing, consulting, architecture, and other supporting functions—are engaged in the right opportunities and implemented effectively.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of Life Sciences industry experience and knowledge, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, and healthcare, with an understanding of industry customers, market dynamics, supply chain complexities, regulatory requirements, and digital transformation trends.
* Deep understanding of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and CDMO manufacturing environments and the business, operational, quality, and technology priorities shaping these markets.
* Knowledge of FDA, EMA, and other global Life Sciences regulatory frameworks, including GxP requirements such as GMP, GCP, and GLP, as well as GAMP 5 principles.
* Experience with Life Sciences digital transformation initiatives and technologies, including MES, Electronic Batch Records (EBR), PLM, laboratory informatics, quality management systems, industrial data management, AI, digital thread, and digital twin technologies.
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.
* Ability to travel approximately 30–40%.
* Must be eligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding Siemens’ portfolio, with the ability to identify and apply relevant solutions across Digital Industries, Smart Infrastructure, Mobility, Software, Financial Services, and consulting offerings to address Life Sciences customer needs.
* Proven ability to drive strategic business development in highly regulated environments, including identifying growth opportunities, developing account strategies, and navigating complex sales cycles and customer pursuits.
* Ability to translate Siemens technologies and digitalization capabilities into meaningful customer outcomes, such as accelerating drug development and technology transfer, improving manufacturing efficiency and quality, increasing asset availability, strengthening regulatory compliance, and reducing operational risk.
* Ability to engage credibly with customers on Life Sciences reference architectures, digital manufacturing strategies, and technology roadmaps.
* Strong customer-facing and executive credibility with senior leaders across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and CDMO organizations.
* Demonstrated understanding of the broader Life Sciences ecosystem, including technology partners, OEMs and machine builders, engineering and system integration partners, and industry organizations such as ISPE.

jobs.title: CAD Administrator 4
jobs.description:
**The Company**

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

**Meet the team:**

As a CAD Administrator IV within the Engineering Enablement team, you will independently support and optimize CAD and PDM environments for multidisciplinary engineering teams. This advanced individual-contributor role champions CAD best practices, data integrity, standardized workflows, and scalable use of engineering design tools. You will collaborate with Engineering, IT, PLM, Procurement, and software vendors to resolve complex issues, guide users and other administrators, maintain current software licensing, and improve how CAD work gets done across the organization.

**Where you come in:**

* You will own CAD and PDM administrative activities, including system configuration, troubleshooting, user support, and license management.

* You will champion CAD best practices, data integrity, and standardized workflows across engineering teams to improve consistency, efficiency, and collaboration.

* You will support CAD/PDM environments and engineering data practices, including user access, configuration, workflow support, version control, and integration with PLM and related systems.

* You will serve as a technical escalation point for complex CAD/PDM issues, partnering with engineering teams to determine practical solutions that protect data integrity and enable work to proceed effectively.

* You will manage the CAD Support Request process from intake through requester-confirmed closure, coordinating review, troubleshooting, communication, blocker resolution, escalation, and documentation.

* You will coordinate license assignments, utilization monitoring, maintenance, and renewals with IT, Procurement, application owners, and software vendors to keep CAD tools current and available.

You will lead continuous improvement of CAD workflows, standards, tools, and support practices, and provide guidance to less-experienced administrators and users.  



**What makes you successful:**

* You have minimum 5 years of relevant experience in SolidWorks CAD and EPDM application support, engineering software administration, license management, technical support, or a related field.

* You have experience administering engineering software licenses and supporting CAD applications.

* You have experience with license-server administration and coordination with IT infrastructure or application teams.

* You have experience managing the full lifecycle of technical support requests, including intake, prioritization, status tracking, documentation, escalation, requester communication, and closure.

* You have an understanding of software licensing, user access, entitlement allocation, and utilization tracking.

* You have an ability to diagnose complex software, access, configuration, connectivity, and licensing issues using a structured, evidence-based troubleshooting approach.

* You have a strong organization, prioritization, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication skills.

* You have the ability to work independently within established procedures and collaborate across technical and business teams.

* You have demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cases, coordinate cross-functional resolution, improve support processes, and guide less-experienced team members.

* You have hands-on experience administering SolidWorks PDM environments, including CAD data management, user access, configuration, workflow support, and data integrity.

You have an understanding of engineering change processes, product-design workflows, engineering bills of materials, and CAD/PDM integration with PLM and manufacturing systems.  



**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience supporting SolidWorks CAD tools in an engineering or product-development environment.

* Experience working with software vendors and supporting renewal or procurement activities.

* Experience developing troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, training content, or support-process improvements.

Familiarity with software compliance practices, controlled documentation, and access-management procedures.

jobs.title: Science Lab Technician
jobs.description:
The Science Laboratory Technician performs specialized technical work in support of undergraduate instructional laboratories across the physical sciences and related scientific disciplines. This position applies scientific principles, laboratory techniques, quantitative calculations, and technical problem-solving to prepare, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory experiments, instrumentation, and equipment.

Working in collaboration with faculty, course laboratory coordinators, and laboratory operations staff, the technician interprets experimental protocols, determines material and equipment requirements, prepares chemical solutions and reagents, evaluates equipment functionality, and resolves technical issues that affect laboratory readiness and experimental outcomes. The position requires an understanding of scientific methods, laboratory instrumentation, chemical properties, and safe laboratory practices to support consistent, reliable, and safe instructional experiences.

The technician exercises independent judgment in organizing laboratory preparation activities, adapting established procedures to available equipment and materials, identifying technical and safety concerns, and maintaining compliance with university policies and applicable regulations. The position also supports laboratory inventory and procurement, hazardous-material management, documentation, and the training and work direction of student employees.

Responsibilities

**Laboratory Preparation and Experimental Implementation**

* Interpret experimental protocols and laboratory procedures to determine the equipment, chemicals, reagents, materials, quantities, and preparation methods required for assigned experiments.
* Calculate and prepare chemical solutions, reagents, dilutions, and other laboratory materials using appropriate scientific calculations, measurement techniques, and established procedures.
* Assemble and configure experimental apparatus, laboratory stations, and materials according to established protocols and technical specifications.
* Test experimental setups and prepared materials to identify discrepancies or conditions that could affect the execution or reliability of laboratory activities.
* Apply scientific principles and systematic troubleshooting methods to resolve preparation errors, experimental setup issues, reagent discrepancies, and other technical problems.
* Determine material quantities and prepare appropriate allocations of supplies based on experimental protocols, enrollment figures, and scheduled laboratory activities.
* Develop, maintain, and revise laboratory preparation sheets, material lists, and experiment-specific technical instructions.
* Verify the identity, concentration where applicable, labeling, and readiness of prepared solutions and materials before use.
* Organize and maintain laboratory preparation areas to ensure materials and experimental setups are ready for scheduled instructional activities.
  

**Laboratory Equipment, Instrumentation, Inventory, and Procurement**

* Operate, inspect, assemble, and test laboratory equipment, scientific instruments, and apparatus to determine functionality and readiness for use.
* Perform routine preventive maintenance, operational checks, and basic calibration where applicable, following equipment specifications and established procedures.
* Diagnose routine equipment malfunctions and performance issues; determine when specialized repair or technical support is required.
* Coordinate equipment servicing and repairs with vendors, service providers, and appropriate university personnel.
* Maintain equipment records, including inventory, location, condition, maintenance, and service history, as applicable.
* Monitor laboratory supplies and consumables, assess inventory levels, anticipate replenishment needs, and identify shortages that could affect laboratory operations.
* Prepare purchase requests, place orders through university purchasing systems, communicate with vendors, coordinate receipt of materials, and monitor order status.
* Reconcile purchasing card transactions and maintain supporting procurement documentation in accordance with university procedures.
* Evaluate equipment and supply options and recommend practical, cost-conscious solutions to meet laboratory needs.
* Receive, assemble, test, and organize newly acquired equipment and materials; maintain accurate inventory records for items received.

**Laboratory Safety, Hazardous Materials, and Regulatory Compliance**

* Apply university laboratory safety policies, established procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements to assigned laboratory activities.
* Assess chemical hazards and compatibility to support appropriate chemical storage, segregation, labeling, and handling practices.
* Collect, label, segregate, store and document the disposal of hazardous laboratory waste in accordance with university procedures and applicable requirements.
* Inspect assigned laboratory areas and chemical storage locations for safety deficiencies, improper storage, labeling issues, and other potential hazards.
* Correct safety deficiencies within the scope of the position and promptly report hazards or compliance concerns requiring additional action.
* Maintain required safety and compliance records, including hazardous-waste documentation, chemical-related records, and applicable inspection documentation to prepare for EHS inspections.
* Review and update laboratory safety procedures and related documentation to support consistent practices and compliance with applicable requirements.

**Instructional Coordination, Technical Guidance, and Student Employee Oversight**

* Coordinate laboratory schedules, preparation timelines, and operational requirements with faculty, instructors, and laboratory operations staff.
* Communicate course-specific logistical needs, equipment limitations, material shortages, and scheduling conflicts to relevant personnel in a timely mann

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
As a **Laboratory Technician** at IDEXX, you perform laboratory testing that helps veterinarians diagnose and treat pets. You will be a key contributor at one of the largest veterinary diagnostic companies in the world, joining a fast-paced work environment that encourages teamwork, quality, and offers opportunities for personal growth.

We offer extensive training for this role, whether you’ve worked in a lab before or this would be your first lab job; we hope you’ll consider applying and discover the good you can do on our team.

**Please note: The start date for these roles will be between December 15-December 31****st** **2026. Please read on for information about these positions!** This is a full-time position with excellent day-one benefits.

If you’d like more information about laboratory jobs at IDEXX before applying, you can explore our Laboratory Careers web page: https://careers.idexx.com/us/en/referencelaboratories

**Why this role matters:**
--------------------------

IDEXX reference laboratories is a global network united by a shared commitment to enhancing pet care, where the true strength in our name is the people behind it, including this role. Our reference laboratories make it possible for our customers to discover more with our unrelenting commitment to innovation, personalized support, guidance, and expertise, while providing the most complete and advanced menu of diagnostic tests along with technology and tools. The focus on enhancing the lives of people and pets starts with our own employees and empowering them to achieve their goals, focusing on continuous improvement, and supporting the strong collaboration and inclusiveness that exist in our team.

**In this role:**
-----------------

We have positions that will have you working in 2 departments: Sample Management and Parasitology.

**What you’ll be doing as a Sample Management Technician:**

* You will receive, prepare, and accession veterinary samples (blood, urine, feces, and biopsies) for laboratory analysis and testing.
* You can expect to remove specimens from transport bags and enter specimen data into a computer tracking system.
* You will rack and bundle prepared samples for delivery to each testing department.
* You will assist other lab personnel with specimen storage and ensuring that Turnaround Times (TAT's) are met.

**What you’ll be doing as a Parasitology Technician:**

* You can learn a lot about the health of a pet from what’s happening in the litter box or backyard. In this role, you will be working with fecal samples to prepare them for analysis.
* You will use automated analyzers, microscopes, and other laboratory diagnostic tools
* You will be moving fecal samples through various steps as we prepare them for testing, and then you’ll load and unload the samples into our analyzers.
* You’ll be following SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to ensure that we move the samples through our testing process correctly and efficiently. Your work will directly help someone’s pet stay healthy.

**What you need to succeed:**
-----------------------------

* You have experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume work environment, and you thrive in that type of workplace. Examples of this could be food service jobs, warehouse positions, high-volume shipping companies, and much more.
* You have outstanding attention to detail abilities and a proven track record of being someone who pays attention to the steps in a process.
* A High School diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience is required. A 2-, 3-, or 4-year degree in a Science-related field is preferred.
* It is not required to work in our lab, but if you were a Veterinary Technician (RVT, LVT, CVT) or Medical Laboratory Technician (MLT or MT), this experience and education would be a plus.
* You have a positive attitude and love to bring that energy into the lab every day to support your colleagues
* You are looking forward to working in a team
* You have a great sense of team spirit and responsibility
* Able to meet the physical requirements that go with working in a lab – standing and sitting for extended periods of time, phone & computer use, extended reach, lifting up to 50lb, and specific vision ability – close, color, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* This is a laboratory, so there is potential exposure to biohazards, agents known to cause zoonotic diseases, and hazardous chemicals.

**What you can expect from us:**
--------------------------------

* Hourly target rate: $25 / hour
* Opportunity for annual cash bonus and merit pay increase consideration
* Health / Dental / Vision benefits from day one
* 5% matching 401k
* On-the-job training and career advancement opportunities
* Additional benefits including but not limited to financial support, pet insurance, mental health resources, volunteer paid days off, employee stock program, foundation donation matching, and more
* The opportunity to do meaningful work where you positively impact the lives of people and pets all over the world

**Schedule:**
-------------

* The hours for this position are 5 am - 2:30 pm Tues - Sat., with a rotating schedule every other Monday.
* The shifts and hours may vary slightly depending on business needs.
* Reliable and dependable attendance is an essential function of the position.

**Why IDEXX:**
--------------

We’re proud of the work we do because our work matters. An innovation leader in every industry we serve since 1983, our team members help pet owners worldwide keep their companion animals healthy and happy, ensure safe drinking water for billions, and help farmers protect livestock and poultry from disease.

We have customers in over 175 countries and a collaborative global workforce. Our culture is one that embraces challenges and encourages learning and discovery. At IDEXX, you’ll be supported by competitive compensation, incentives, and benefits while enjoying purposeful work that drives improvement.

jobs.description:
Overview:

**JOB TITLE:** Laboratory Assistant /

**DEPARTMENT:** Medical

**REPORTS TO:** Senior Operations Manager

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

The phlebotomist technician position is responsible for performing venipuncture and other specimen collection procedures to obtain samples for laboratory testing and diagnostic purposes.

Phlebotomist must ensure proper patient identification, specimen collection, labeling, processing and handling to maintain specimen integrity and patient safety. Phlebotomists will interact with patient and medical providers to deliver high-quality care and support by following laboratory procedures.

Responsibilities:

**DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensures that the critical safety process is required to properly identify every patient through two independent patient identifiers “before” drawing blood or collecting specimens. For example:
  + Asking the patient to state their full name and date of birth (D.O.B.), rather than just reading out their name & D.O.B.
  + Verifying that the patient’s stated (verbally) information perfectly matches the lab requisition order, the E.H.R. and the specimen tube labels.
* Assesses patient needs, reviewing patient history, printing the correct provider Lab Requisition order, and determining the reason(s) for drawing blood.
* Verifies and collects proper samples required for specific tests and accurately labels specimens.
* Performs venipuncture, capillary punctures, and other specimen collection procedures according to his/her Phlebotomist training/certification and established protocols.
* Labels and handles specimens according to established protocols and laboratory standards- following own safety first practices.
* Analyzes blood specimens using the correct testing equipment.
* Prepares specimens for transportation/pick-up, including placing specimens in the correct laboratory collection box and ensuring to maintain specimens at the required temperature.
* Maintains accurate records of all specimens collected and ensures timely data entry in patients Electronic Health Record (E.H.R.).
* Collects and inputs accurate data for billing reimbursement purposes.
* Complies with all HIPAA regulations and maintains strict confidentiality of all patients protected health information (PHI).
* Complies with all quality control standards and equipment maintenance and cleans, maintains and calibrates all laboratory equipment in strict accordance with manufacturer instructions. maintains all laboratory equipment clean and calibrated according to manufacturer guidelines.

  

* Maintains the laboratory clean, organized, and well-stocked.
* Keeps open communication with Laboratories (Quest, LabCorp, Foundation Lab, etc.) to ensure specimen pick-ups are scheduled timely.
* Serves as a liaison between patients, the laboratory, and FHCCGLA to resolve billing inquiries and discrepancies.
* Coordinates with vendors and laboratory representatives regarding supply orders and deliveries.
* Maintains cost-effective inventory practices and reports supply needs to immediate supervisor.

  

* Assist with drawing blood for OB AFP testing
* Assists with training and mentoring new phlebotomy staff when assigned.
* Collaborates with healthcare providers and other FHCCGLA staff to ensure efficient workflow and quality patient care
* Ensures to check on a monthly basis for any expired items and keep a log for audit purposes.
* Ensures proper utilization of equipment and supplies to avoid waste or damage.
* Continuously works toward establishing a good rapport and cooperative working relationship with all FHCCGLA providers & co-workers.
* Inspires confidence from patients and visitors by always performing and communicating in a professional manner
* Ability to handle unexpected and stressful situations (e.g., walk-ins, surges, etc.) and deals with each patient professionally demonstrating a friendly demeanor.
* Adheres to all OSHA, CLIA, and infection control standards.
* Seeks assistance from a medical provider as needed for emergencies or other support as necessary (e.g., difficult blood draw, etc.).
* Completes / Attends the following meetings/trainings:
  + Mandatory Quarterly Staff Trainings (Jan., Apri., Jul., & Oct.) via Paylocity.
  + Any other pertinent meeting requested by leadership (advance notice will be provided when feasible).
* All other duties as assigned (may be modified as business needs dictate).

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma, required.
* Certification with the American Society of Phlebotomy Technicians, Inc. and/or the National Phlebotomy Association (NPA).
* Current BLS Certification, required to be kept up to date.
* Two years of phlebotomy experience, preferred.
* FQHC experience, highly preferred.
* Motivation to take the Initiative to ensure all tasks performed are completed thoroughly and accurately.
* Computer knowledge (e.g., NextGen (E.H.R. & PMS), Microsoft Word & Excel)- preferred.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. Bilingual (English/Spanish) with the ability to speak/write fluently.
* Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Willingness to travel to and from FHCCGLA sites as well as attend off-site events, meetings, trainings. Requires access to an automobile and must possess a valid California Driver’s License and state mandated automobile insurance.
* Commitment to FHCCGLA’s Mission & Vision (refer to the Employee Handbook).
* Willingness to adapt to changes (e.g., schedules) with regards to the agency’s growth & expansion.

  

* Ability to prioritize workload and work under pressure to meet tight, sensitive deadlines.
* Motivated and committed to the provision of high-quality healthcare for indigent and underserved communities.
* Commitment to the provision of high-quality health care services and the goals and mission of Family Health Care Centers of Greater Los Angeles, Inc.
* Willingness and ability to adapt to changes and perform tasks in a changing work envir

To perform venipuncture and skin puncture and pre-analytical and post analytical steps of laboratory testing.
